question: Which of the following states launched the first Migration Monitoring System in the year 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Maharashtra** launched the first Migration Monitoring System in the year 2022.
 
• The system aims to track the movement of migrant workers and ensure their welfare.
 
• It is designed to collect data on various parameters including the health, education, and employment status of migrant workers.
